answer.en: Sessions are available in Amharic and English. Mention your preference when booking.
answer.am: ቆይታዎች በአማርኛ እና በእንግሊዝኛ ይካሄዳሉ። ቀጠሮ ሲይዙ ምርጫዎን ይግለጹ።

question.en: What if I need a different time?

answer.en: Contact us before your appointment to discuss changing the time.
